comment: Names and templates of the access catalog (acc.* in i18n.ts), shared with tools/access_help.py for the help pages. Every key in both languages.

de.probe: Erkennungsabfrage; eine Kennung meldet nur Patch-Firmware

patch.no: braucht EMU1101-EXT ab {{v}}; dieses Pack hat sie nicht
patch.unknown: braucht EMU1101-EXT ab {{v}}; auf dieser Verbindung nicht belegt

flag.unknown: Imageflag Bit {{bit}} ({{name}}) nicht belegt (ein gespeicherter Beleg kennt keine Imageflags)

de.bitUnread: Group{{g}}.Bit{{b}}{{name}} muss {{want}} sein, noch nicht gelesen
de.baseLow: braucht Firmware ab {{from}}, dieses Pack hat {{now}}
de.baseUnknown: braucht Firmware ab {{from}}; die genaue Version zeigt nur die Firmwarekennung (64/03)
de.slavesNone: nur am Master mit Slaves; er arbeitet gerade ohne (Einzelpack oder Wartung)
de.slavesUnknown: nur am Master mit Slaves; Slavezahl nicht bekannt

reason.view-only: „Nur ansehen“: Schreiben braucht eine Verbindung mit Anlage
reason.quiet-bus: RS485-1/2: zuverlässig nur bei angehaltenem Master oder einzelnem Pack
reason.local-board: nur die Platine, an deren Displayport das Display bzw. Bluetooth-Modul steckt (Displayport aktiv, Group7.Bit3)
reason.not-implemented: Die Firmware hat diesen Weg; die App nutzt ihn nicht.

doc.bitBuild: Freigabe in Group{{g}}.Bit{{b}} ({{name}}), Wert je Build (siehe Funktionsschalter {{g}})
doc.notInApp: die App nutzt diesen Weg nicht

yields.both-serials: liefert Batterie- und BMS-Seriennummer, je bis 30 Zeichen
yields.battery-string1: liefert nur die Batterie-Seriennummer (String 1), die ersten 22 Zeichen

act.hard-stop: Set the hard stop at a recharge pause
act.read-soc-store: Read stored state and energy counters

en.probe: detection query; only patched firmware reports an identity

patch.no: needs EMU1101-EXT from {{v}}; this pack does not have it
patch.unknown: needs EMU1101-EXT from {{v}}; not proven on this connection

flag.no: image flag bit {{bit}} ({{name}}) missing on this pack
flag.unknown: image flag bit {{bit}} ({{name}}) not proven (a stored proof knows no image flags)

flagName.b0: hard stop as the build default
flagName.b4: identity and maintenance marker over RS485-1/2

cap.no: read capability {{name}} not reported by this pack

en.bitUnread: Group{{g}}.bit{{b}}{{name}} must be {{want}}, not read yet
en.baseLow: needs firmware from {{from}}, this pack has {{now}}
en.baseUnknown: needs firmware from {{from}}; only the firmware identity (64/03) shows the exact version
en.slavesNone: only at a master with slaves; it works without any now (single pack or maintenance)
en.slavesUnknown: only at a master with slaves; slave count not known

reason.view-only: “View only”: writing needs a connection with an installation
reason.quiet-bus: RS485-1/2: reliable only with the master halted or a single pack
reason.local-board: only the board whose display port the display or Bluetooth module is plugged into (display port on, Group7.bit3)
reason.not-implemented: The firmware has this path; the app does not use it.

doc.capBits: read capability {{names}} (bit {{bits}} of the firmware identity)
doc.bitBuild: release in Group{{g}}.bit{{b}} ({{name}}), value per build (see function switch {{g}})
doc.withSlaves: only at a master with slaves
doc.localBoard: only the board at the display port
doc.quietBus: reliable only without a polling master
doc.notInApp: the app does not use this way

yields.both-serials: returns battery and BMS serial number, up to 30 characters each
yields.battery-string1: returns only the battery serial number (String 1), its first 22 characters

yields.both-serials: both numbers, up to 30 characters each

short.probe: detection query, identity only from patched firmware
